title: The Source Arts Conference
summary: In the Daoyi stone pavilion's vault, the final between Gu Feng and Tuoba Chang is played over three rounds. Gu Feng notices that Tuoba's right hand resembles imitation goods not from the Eastern Wasteland and wonders whether it is technology. In round one Tuoba secretly swaps their stones, so Gu Feng gets Frost Dew Source worth 200 jin against Tuoba's Blazing Fire Source worth 200,000. In round two Gu Feng uses a disguise-and-swap trick of his own and his 36 opening moves to cut a Black-Gold Dragon-Pattern sword worth 550,000, while Tuoba cuts true Divine Source worth 500,000, which leaves Tuoba ahead overall, 700,000 to 550,200. In the deciding round Tuoba tries to absorb Gu Feng's divine sense through the Golden-Red Divine Hand. Gu Feng turns it around, shatters Tuoba's divine sense so he loses his memory, and demands to know about the 'king' behind the Tuoba family. When Gu Feng cuts his last stone, the Ancient Divine Silkworm flies out.
events: Gu Feng suspects Tuoba's hand is technology
